QUOTE: Engine → caller, `char*` return or `char**` out-param | Caller owns it and must call `entropic_free()`. ... Engine → caller, `const char*` / static | Do not free. | `entropic_version` returns a static string.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states the char* ownership/entropic_free rule but not that a const char* is handle-owned and valid only until the next call on that handle. It only says const char*/static is not freed, citing a static version string.
